senses.definition: n.f. a tree, AV cypress, RV holm-tree, but very dub.: TrNHB 338 PostHast. DB Cypress; 𝔙 ilex, and so M’LeanEncy. Bib. Cypress;—abs. ת׳ Is 44:14 (+ אַלּוֹן, ‖ אֲרָזִים).
